_comment: #839: one tool snapshot in the shape recorded before 2026-11-19 (QueryScope still has max_operations/max_tool_seconds; ToolRegistration has no citable_as_fact). Structure from an archived F1 recording; identifiers synthetic.

description.cannot_prove: A slice proves only the rows it shows: rows of the kept result outside [offset, offset + returned) are unknown from this view, and a slice is not the whole result, so no total, maximum, minimum or absence may be read from it. The kept result itself (the over-limit refusal's evidence_id) is not citable; cite the slice. A single row larger than the view limit cannot be read this way; narrow the original query.
description.limits: offset (at least 0, default 0) and limit (at least 1) count rows under the parent tool's result path: series for metrics_range_query, spans for traces_search, names or values for the discovery tools. An offset at or past total_rows returns no_data. The whole slice view is limited to the registered max_view_tokens (25,000 DeepSeek tokens): a larger slice is refused with RESULT_TOO_LARGE and no rows, never cut; read fewer rows. Only an evidence_id from an over-limit refusal of this Run can be read; any other is denied with EVIDENCE_NOT_READABLE.
description.returns: Rows of one over-limit result this Run kept as un-adopted evidence, read back from the gateway's evidence store: the rows offset to offset + limit - 1 under the parent tool's result path, with parent_tool and a slice header; source, window and time fields are the parent's.
description.values_format: The authorized target for this Run is appended as {values}; only a result kept from that target is readable.
description.window_format: The parent result's query window, which lies inside the authorized window appended as {window}; a slice never reads outside it.

evidence_id.description: evidence_id of a kept over-limit result.
